actuarial.headline: Second Edition of the CAS AI Primer Now Available
actuarial.summary: CAS released an updated primer on AI use in actuarial practice, expanding guidance as AI adoption accelerates — a reference point for P&C actuaries navigating AI/ML in pricing, reserving, and underwriting.

actuarial.headline: 2025 Variance Prize Honors Research on Credibility Theory and Machine Learning
actuarial.summary: CAS's Variance journal prize went to a paper on adjusting manual rates to own experience, blending classical credibility theory with machine learning — directly relevant to commercial-lines ratemaking.

actuarial.headline: Munich Re Specialty launches parametric earthquake insurance for corporates in Japan
actuarial.summary: New parametric earthquake cover for Japanese corporate clients via the Lloyd's Japan platform, offering rapid post-quake liquidity — a commercial property product launch amid this week's Kumamoto earthquake.

data_science.headline: Low-Rank Dependence Decomposition via Accelerated Symmetric Non-negative Matrix Factorization
data_science.summary: GPU-scalable symmetric NMF for extracting tail-dependence structure from large correlation matrices via extreme value theory — applicable to portfolio and catastrophe risk-factor estimation at scale.

data_science.headline: Debiased Machine Learning: Identification, Estimation, and Shape Constraints
data_science.summary: Extends automatic debiased ML to shape-constrained settings with endogeneity, correcting regularization bias when nuisance functions are ML-estimated — useful for causal estimation in pricing and reserving work.

data_science.headline: On Non-Stationary Dynamic Pricing: Adaptivity and Optimality
data_science.summary: Adaptive contextual pricing algorithm with change-point detection achieves best-of-both-worlds regret under unknown non-stationarity — directly relevant to actuarial rate adaptation and usage-based pricing schemes.

data_science.headline: Learning Switched Non-Linear Dynamical Systems from a Single Trajectory
data_science.summary: Non-asymptotic bounds for learning regime-switching dynamics from one observed trajectory — relevant to modeling regime shifts in claims frequency, mortality trends, or economic scenario generation.

data_science.headline: Causal-TS: A Python Library for Causal Discovery in High-Dimensional and Nonstationary Time Series
data_science.summary: Open-source library for causal discovery with regime detection in multivariate nonstationary time series — a practical tool for investigating causal drivers behind shifting loss trends.

data_science.headline: Don't Just "Throw Adam at It": Misunderstanding Adam Will Cost You
data_science.summary: Explainer on how misunderstanding the Adam optimizer's dynamics leads to poorly tuned neural nets — practical reading for teams building deep learning models on tabular actuarial data.
